sp1_audit.mechanism_match: CONFIRMED. Pre-fix failure class was interpreter-shutdown flushing (CPython block-buffers pipe stdout; flush_std_files() in finalization raises unraisable BrokenPipeError -> 'Exception ignored' diagnostic + exit 120). _announce_pass (scripts/node27_c4_production_acceptance.py:66-79) forces print+sys.stdout.flush() inside main(), converting EPIPE into a catchable error at a controlled point. Catch is narrowed to BrokenPipeError only; the verifier's warned-against terminal broad except is absent.
sp1_audit.redirect_soundness: CONFIRMED. sys.stdout rebound to open('/dev/null','w') before return: shutdown flush_std_files() flushes the new empty stream; the original stream stays referenced by sys.__stdout__ and CPython's IOBase finalizer silences close() errors, so no shutdown diagnostic can reappear. Fallback except OSError only degrades to pre-fix behavior on non-POSIX (no /dev/null) — out of domain for this Linux-only tool (/usr/bin/node, 0700/0600 POSIX modes).
sp1_audit.semantics_preserved: CONFIRMED. Stage publishes before _announce_pass is called; artifact-then-announce order unchanged for all three stages. Static owner-coded stderr outcome 'C4_STDOUT_CLOSED: ...' and return 1 exactly match the approved R1 resolution. Refusal path (_report, stderr-only) and usage path (argparse override -> stderr, exit 2) leave stdout buffer empty, so no sibling broken-pipe exposure exists on non-success paths. Exit lattice 0/1/2 unchanged for all pre-fix paths; only the former 120+diagnostic case becomes static-1.
sp1_audit.subprocess_test: SOUND. tests/test_node27_c4_production_acceptance_boundaries.py:367-408 closes the pipe read end BEFORE Popen (deterministic EPIPE on the child's first flush; cacd38641 replaced the racy select/read-then-close intermediate that could flush successfully before closing). pass_fds + parent-side close correct; stderr read before wait cannot deadlock (bounded output). Assertions cover rc==1, static code present, 'BrokenPipeError' and 'Exception ignored' absent, published freeze re-parsed through the real read_private_json (0600/single-link/euid reader) with correct stage/reviewed_sha, and no stray binding.
sp1_audit.resource_cleanup: No leak relevant to a short-lived CLI: pipe fds closed in parent; devnull stream flush-clean at shutdown; child fds reaped at exit.
